items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system, and it has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, for affected versions 2.4.4 through 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, but it is separate from the CVE-2026-75650 hotfix.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.
